data.description: Personal Projects Below are some of the things I have done in my spare time, not always directly affiliated with UTD. I'm a tinkerer, and I really like embedded programming as well as Android projects in Java.

data.title: Robot built for the workshop at PES University.
Home Monitoring and Control system running at my house. This uses a combination of Arduino and Raspberry Pi boards.
Android Pong Game. This is the first app I have released to the Google Play Store. It's available free, and was done in part as a UTD project. You can find it using my name and "Pong."
